Mixing aspirin and alcohol ` [Highlight start] increases the risk of stomach irritation, ulcers, and gastrointestinal bleeding [Highlight end] ` . Both substances irritate the stomach lining, and aspirin also reduces blood clotting, making any bleeding more serious.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZEeoOOPb5oDfd_ld0xz_pJ6zJYF_cTe_LCGfWj4GLuKwpjJHsnSJLnNabzUEWz3Y4af9uvrzl4WmRhVE3iNYNkgqR0ViVL0MoWtxGJ71mLr-W1pjpoylvnEgDSBP4ezv8Dg4Y0GCLQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXPaMK_X2c94UbWn_sLBjNXvAGYQCPXzpCMySuOiFXBlLPqcwBwAcoChSLWax6Ia1Fe5WHDmIwxqCAgqdZ4bAHKTQsUd2W6QIjkNwzYRoBhslpUNuRgn8UITEvR30Blbqh0X8u)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXZurZSpDBgvATLm3SnfqB8OkfZMVbnKZOJ9oh4MXCQVxjaDsWJsjfHD4hM221iMX7fFjTtrWUh6Rt81KZ_69kmYw3CHymLB85jjhyNSWDVCllH_Vk4BXPOmUtsjWmb27JVl6QgOUxY5Ah5YxZA_JG-KFieNDcFRg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXZ57wjCOIdMicGRtuqtL_QucwCwn5112PFs15PPnLRAOq6WTZU0-CfmX94jn0C7Q9d_CgTTKNCT30SIMwJkTZ_qXAIfUf2z0liOuD3gKmuoABa1kkl1ZdrbQQeUDL75cmCiWP2uJO)

### Key Risks

- **Stomach upset and ulcers:** Nausea, heartburn, vomiting, and damage to the stomach lining can occur even with low-dose ("baby") aspirin.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXPaMK_X2c94UbWn_sLBjNXvAGYQCPXzpCMySuOiFXBlLPqcwBwAcoChSLWax6Ia1Fe5WHDmIwxqCAgqdZ4bAHKTQsUd2W6QIjkNwzYRoBhslpUNuRgn8UITEvR30Blbqh0X8u)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZEeoOOPb5oDfd_ld0xz_pJ6zJYF_cTe_LCGfWj4GLuKwpjJHsnSJLnNabzUEWz3Y4af9uvrzl4WmRhVE3iNYNkgqR0ViVL0MoWtxGJ71mLr-W1pjpoylvnEgDSBP4ezv8Dg4Y0GCLQ)
- **Gastrointestinal bleeding:** Heavy or frequent drinking combined with regular aspirin use significantly raises the risk of bleeding in the stomach or intestines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1xq7ngxN9jHl945dC44FyFuiO3XK56U8tYN_w4VGNaGpIw4ZX14F5mO4PHVmEsmSHDQQeDbsv1YNZ_PWmpPDhgvBzQA5b5C92IWx3qf599H3BTtbtYZ_LUvY1h3ueBzrmlxTzHm8oI3EKbTBPLOzgHVVpZwK24pvJM8BuicnRmmdfxfd-znvgA5PlLFrFkSdfBQAgLwVVBNfMmSX4xXT9-hUf_4rQ0j-qT9c0jdswBG6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZEeoOOPb5oDfd_ld0xz_pJ6zJYF_cTe_LCGfWj4GLuKwpjJHsnSJLnNabzUEWz3Y4af9uvrzl4WmRhVE3iNYNkgqR0ViVL0MoWtxGJ71mLr-W1pjpoylvnEgDSBP4ezv8Dg4Y0GCLQ)
- **Warning signs of bleeding:** Seek immediate medical care if you notice black or tarry stools, blood in your stool, or vomit that looks like blood or coffee grounds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXzbVlOyalsADY_FsDa2kiuXVM5BHN4owNQmel21RqXPk7rhhkdzU4yfqVBZhHYyXu5dDwO96JhSvscxpbXVoxigESxjF6u_Zo66oIn9VclH1krligMJzzc2E5gUF0SxfwbNuTMG5CAERVVg)

### Practical Precautions

- **Limit alcohol:** If a doctor approves alcohol while you take aspirin, keep intake low—generally no more than 1 drink per day for women and men over 65, and up to 2 drinks per day for men under 65. Avoid heavy or binge drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZEeoOOPb5oDfd_ld0xz_pJ6zJYF_cTe_LCGfWj4GLuKwpjJHsnSJLnNabzUEWz3Y4af9uvrzl4WmRhVE3iNYNkgqR0ViVL0MoWtxGJ71mLr-W1pjpoylvnEgDSBP4ezv8Dg4Y0GCLQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXZurZSpDBgvATLm3SnfqB8OkfZMVbnKZOJ9oh4MXCQVxjaDsWJsjfHD4hM221iMX7fFjTtrWUh6Rt81KZ_69kmYw3CHymLB85jjhyNSWDVCllH_Vk4BXPOmUtsjWmb27JVl6QgOUxY5Ah5YxZA_JG-KFieNDcFRg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXFXDP3kr7O-69USNzGq5aGI7mcnKqwmBXm6Pru32Yjqt2Geai1sepCZCYu3rzkL2rSOO_ZoNpIAMz3m5epop1Rj8ZxQbHihiLu9H88XYxf459XobF4FEpAjAm6fciGHCeCtyAveWp7f-CPUHIXg)
- **Space them out:** Avoid taking aspirin immediately before, during, or right after drinking. For more details on timing and side effects, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZEeoOOPb5oDfd_ld0xz_pJ6zJYF_cTe_LCGfWj4GLuKwpjJHsnSJLnNabzUEWz3Y4af9uvrzl4WmRhVE3iNYNkgqR0ViVL0MoWtxGJ71mLr-W1pjpoylvnEgDSBP4ezv8Dg4Y0GCLQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXPaMK_X2c94UbWn_sLBjNXvAGYQCPXzpCMySuOiFXBlLPqcwBwAcoChSLWax6Ia1Fe5WHDmIwxqCAgqdZ4bAHKTQsUd2W6QIjkNwzYRoBhslpUNuRgn8UITEvR30Blbqh0X8u)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXZurZSpDBgvATLm3SnfqB8OkfZMVbnKZOJ9oh4MXCQVxjaDsWJsjfHD4hM221iMX7fFjTtrWUh6Rt81KZ_69kmYw3CHymLB85jjhyNSWDVCllH_Vk4BXPOmUtsjWmb27JVl6QgOUxY5Ah5YxZA_JG-KFieNDcFRg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZEeoOOPb5oDfd_ld0xz_pJ6zJYF_cTe_LCGfWj4GLuKwpjJHsnSJLnNabzUEWz3Y4af9uvrzl4WmRhVE3iNYNkgqR0ViVL0MoWtxGJ71mLr-W1pjpoylvnEgDSBP4ezv8Dg4Y0GCLQ)
- **Check with a clinician:** Ask a doctor or pharmacist before combining them if you take daily low-dose aspirin, use blood thinners or other NSAIDs, or have a history of ulcers or liver issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXGBt_fezE4jJHctcQbBG0lGKwzVCsI8Kf_r39ajTNU5eSE2WB_j4FI8my70aidxwCCo7GzYihGPMEpeY7c-8UZfO_lwhyNQarQJ-LR7znaGbFUazsNyvdzUAQbxk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXPaMK_X2c94UbWn_sLBjNXvAGYQCPXzpCMySuOiFXBlLPqcwBwAcoChSLWax6Ia1Fe5WHDmIwxqCAgqdZ4bAHKTQsUd2W6QIjkNwzYRoBhslpUNuRgn8UITEvR30Blbqh0X8u)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXI0Xk-z-2edg60lM4Sj3Sf-DOktqXDYR1juVsbxJ2S8WMdVUOELtJzzlPvfJ-5cW7wIku4xMmjwFIgCLBe6Kb5sNcFL2AG-vR43XQb-rZBtPs-G3ydXjhyy-YnU7vZyWkOdbldvfZ5w)
